cmd:group.note: opens the label picker for the open session (also :groups)

cmd:project.note: :project <name> filters the list to that project (exact, then unique prefix or substring); without a name it opens the picker

cmd:project-delete.note: deletes the named project after a confirm; without a name it asks which

cmd:project-edit.note: edits the named project, else the filtered one, else asks which

cmd:project-new.note: :project-new <name> [path] creates a blue project; without an argument it opens the form

cmd:projects.note: opens the project picker, which filters the list

global:backspace/search-line.note: the filter box is a text input; the list re-filters on every keystroke

global:char/search-line.note: the filter box is a text input; the list re-filters on every keystroke

global:enter/search-line.note: Enter in the filter box keeps the filter and returns to the list

global:esc/normal-mode-with-a-confirmed-.note: Esc in the list (no field focused, no dialog) clears a confirmed filter

global:esc/search-line.note: Esc in the filter box clears it and returns to the list

key:-.note: moves the list cursor to the enclosing Group or Epic row (the tree shows containers inline, so there is no descent level)

key:<Space>1.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>2.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>3.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>4.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>5.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>6.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>7.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>8.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>9.note: jumps to the Nth session that needs you, in list order (needs-you sessions sort first)

key:<Space>C.note: picker that moves the open session to another project (or none)

key:<Space>p.note: project picker that filters the session list to one project (there are no workspace panes in the desktop)

key:<Space>s.note: sort picker with the TUI orders; the choice is kept in local storage

key:F3.note: Session info dialog with the TUI rows (title, id, kind, status, provider, model, dir, project, created, the context-budget rows of types/context_budget.rs detail_rows, parent, lead, sandbox, rating, label, tags, description); R opens the rating dialog and G the label picker, as in the TUI panel

key:H.note: same as -: cursor to the parent row

key:N.note: the previous event, or with no session open the previous matching session (G2)

key:[g.note: cursor to the first row of the previous label group

key:]g.note: cursor to the first row of the next label group

key:mo.note: SetSessionParent with no parent; the daemon rejects kinds that cannot sit at the top level

key:mp.note: picker of Groups and Epics (not the session or its descendants); the daemon enforces the containment rules and its refusal is shown

key:n.note: with a session open, the next conversation event that contains the filter text (the TUI detail search); with none open, the next session the filter matches (G2)

module:ui/overlay/project_picker.rs.note: project picker that filters the session list

module:ui/overlay/session_info.rs.note: session info with the context-budget rows (G2) and R

overlay-ref:label-form.note: Name, Description and Color; Enter saves, Esc cancels

overlay-ref:label-picker.note: type-to-filter; Enter assigns; New / Edit / Delete buttons or Ctrl-N / Ctrl-E / Ctrl-D; a (none) entry clears

overlay-ref:project-form.note: see the project form overlay row

overlay-ref:project-picker.note: see the project picker overlay row

overlay-ref:session-info.note: F3: R rates, G opens the label picker, Esc / q close, Space N / Space ;; the context-budget rows (G2)

overlay-ref:sort-picker.note: see the sort picker overlay row

overlay:project-form-overlay-create-edit.note: Name, Path and Color (the TUI palette as radio swatches); Tab moves, Left/Right cycles the color, Enter saves, Esc cancels

overlay:project-picker-overlay-workspace.note: type-to-filter picker; Enter filters the list to the project; New / Edit / Delete are buttons and Ctrl-N / Ctrl-E / Ctrl-D where the platform leaves them to the page

overlay:sort-picker-overlay-space-s.note: j/k or arrows choose, Enter applies, Esc/q cancels; the current order is ticked

section:navigation-attention-queue.note: ]a / [a and <Space>1-9 and the attention queue dialog

section:project-workspace-navigation.note: the project picker filters the list; the desktop has no per-project workspace panes

section:search.note: live list filter with Enter to confirm and Esc to clear; n / N step through the open conversation's matching events, or the matching sessions with none open. The TUI's file search is the files slice's <Space><Space> picker

section:session-labeling.note: label picker, label chips on rows, ]g / [g, grouped-by-label sort
